title: Add support bundle upload policy design
purpose: Define future support bundle upload behavior while preserving local redaction and explicit operator consent.
scope: Define local-only default for support bundles.
Define future upload preconditions, approval, destination trust and redaction checks.
Define what metadata can be uploaded and what must remain local.
Define failure policy for unavailable or untrusted upload endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Upload is explicitly future work and not enabled by baseline.
Raw secrets and raw prompts remain forbidden surfaces.
Operator approval and destination trust are required for future upload.
Failure policy is fail-closed for untrusted destinations.
failure_modes: Redaction policy is weaker for uploaded bundles.
Untrusted destination can receive support data.
